title: drydock PluginPolicy
description: Editor schema for drydock trusted plugin policy files. The drydock Go parser remains the authoritative security boundary.

apiVersion.description: PluginPolicy API version. Must be drydock.sholdee.dev/v1alpha1.

kind.description: Policy document kind. Must be PluginPolicy.

plugins.description: Mapping from Argo CD spec.source.plugin.name to a drydock policy entry.

bootstrap.description: Trusted plugin-rendered discovery entrypoints for bootstrap Applications or ApplicationSets.
Plugin-rendered discovery inputs for repositories that generate Argo CD bootstrap objects.

entrypoints.description: Non-empty list of trusted plugin sources to render during fleet discovery.

bootstrapEntrypoint.description: One trusted plugin source used to discover rendered Applications or ApplicationSets.

name.description: DNS-label-like identifier for this bootstrap entrypoint.

plugin.description: Plugin policy key to render for this entrypoint.

sourcePath.description: Repository-relative source path rendered by the selected plugin. Use . for the repository root.

parameters.description: Trusted Argo-style plugin parameters supplied to this bootstrap render.

bootstrapEntrypointName.description: Lowercase DNS-label-like name, up to 63 characters.

bootstrapEntrypointParameters.description: Argo-style plugin parameters supplied by trusted policy.

bootstrapEntrypointParameter.description: One trusted bootstrap plugin parameter with exactly one string, array, or map value.

name.description: Parameter name exposed to the plugin.

repoRelativePath.description: Repository-relative path. Absolute paths, backslashes, .git, and parent traversal are rejected.

plugin.description: Trusted behavior for one Argo CD config management plugin name.

avpCompatPlugin.description: Native argocd-vault-plugin placeholder compatibility without running AVP.

engine.description: Use drydock's built-in AVP placeholder compatibility engine.

match.description: Static discovery rule for unnamed Application plugin sources.

configManagementPlugin.description: Optional trusted Argo CD CMP seed for matching or fingerprinting.

nativeKustomizePlugin.description: Use drydock's native Kustomize renderer for a compatible named plugin.

engine.description: Use drydock's native Kustomize compatibility engine.

match.description: Static discovery rule for unnamed Application plugin sources.

configManagementPlugin.description: Optional trusted Argo CD CMP seed for matching or Kustomize options.

execPlugin.description: Trusted host-process plugin execution. Requires --enable-plugins at runtime.

engine.description: Run trusted commands directly on the host.

match.description: Static discovery rule for unnamed Application plugin sources.

configManagementPlugin.description: Optional trusted Argo CD CMP seed for matching or fingerprinting.

workdir.description: Command working directory. Only source is supported.

copy.description: Controls which repository files are copied into the temporary plugin workspace.

generate.description: Required command that writes Kubernetes manifests to stdout.

postRenderers.description: Commands that transform rendered manifests by reading stdin and writing stdout.

env.description: Caller environment variables the plugin may receive.

parameters.description: Application-authored plugin parameters accepted by this policy.

output.description: Per-command stdout and stderr byte limits.

containerPlugin.description: Trusted container plugin execution. Requires --enable-plugins at runtime.

engine.description: Run trusted commands in a container runtime.

match.description: Static discovery rule for unnamed Application plugin sources.

configManagementPlugin.description: Optional trusted Argo CD CMP seed for matching or fingerprinting.

runtime.description: Container runtime used to execute this plugin. Only docker is supported.

image.description: Fully qualified plugin image. A digest is required unless allowMutableImageTag is true.

allowMutableImageTag.description: Allow a tag-only image reference for trusted local workflows.

network.description: Container network mode. default is rejected when drydock runs with --offline.

cacheMounts.description: Policy-managed durable tool caches mounted under /drydock-cache.

workdir.description: Command working directory. Only source is supported.

copy.description: Controls which repository files are copied into the temporary plugin workspace.

generate.description: Required command that writes Kubernetes manifests to stdout.

postRenderers.description: Commands that transform rendered manifests by reading stdin and writing stdout.

env.description: Caller environment variables the plugin may receive.

parameters.description: Application-authored plugin parameters accepted by this policy.

output.description: Per-command stdout and stderr byte limits.

containerCacheMounts.description: Durable caches for trusted container plugins. Host paths are selected by drydock; policy supplies names and container targets.

containerCacheMount.description: One durable cache mount for a trusted container plugin.

name.description: Stable cache name used under drydock's plugin cache root.

target.description: Absolute Linux path below /drydock-cache. Host paths are not accepted; backslashes, traversal, /work, and overlapping targets are rejected.

containerCacheMountName.description: DNS-label-like cache name, up to 63 characters.

match.description: Trusted static discovery rule used to match unnamed plugin sources.

discoverMatch.description: Static source-tree discovery rule. Command discovery is not supported in policy.

fileName.description: Source-relative glob matched against files in the plugin source tree.

glob.description: Source-relative glob matched against files in the plugin source tree.

sourceRelativeGlob.description: Source-relative glob. Absolute paths, backslashes, .git, and parent traversal are rejected.

configManagementPluginSeed.description: Optional safe subset of the Argo CD ConfigManagementPlugin spec. The enclosing plugins map key is the CMP name.

discover.description: Static discovery rule copied from the trusted CMP seed.

generate.description: Generate command and args copied for fingerprinting and compatibility checks.

configManagementPluginGenerateSeed.description: Trusted generate command shape copied from an Argo CD ConfigManagementPlugin.

command.description: Argv command from a CMP seed. It is fingerprinted but not executed by seed code.

args.description: Argv arguments from a CMP seed. They are fingerprinted but not executed by seed code.

copy.description: Controls which files drydock copies into the temporary plugin workspace.

scope.description: source copies only the Application source path; repository permits allowlisted sibling paths.

include.description: Repository-relative glob allowlist required when copy.scope is repository.

command.description: Argv sequence. Shell strings and empty tokens are rejected.

env.description: Environment variables allowed from the caller environment.

allow.description: Variable names the plugin may receive from the caller environment.

parameters.description: Application-authored plugin parameters accepted by policy.

required.description: Require the Application to supply this parameter.

path.description: Treat a string parameter as a constrained path.

parameterPath.description: Path constraints for a string Application parameter.

base.description: Base directory used to validate the path: source or repository.

allow.description: Allowed path patterns relative to the selected base.

maxStdoutBytes.description: Maximum stdout bytes accepted from each command.

maxStderrBytes.description: Maximum stderr bytes retained from each command.
